title: Three priciest products
statementMd:
Which three products have the highest price? Highest first.

Expected columns: `name`, `price`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
